decision.explanation: Document d00 and d01 explicitly describe the New York School as a group of poets (Ashbery, O'Hara, etc.) whose primary activity was writing poetry, while noting their connection to visual artists; document d03 distinguishes this literary group from the 'New York School abstract expressionist painters,' stating that for the latter group, the primary medium was abstract expressionist painting, indicating two distinct referents sharing the name.
